# directus_policy (Data Source)

Reads a Directus access policy by id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the policy to look up.

### Read-Only

- `admin_access` (Boolean) Whether full admin access is granted.
- `app_access` (Boolean) Whether app access is granted.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enforce_tfa` (Boolean) Whether TFA is enforced.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name.
- `ip_access` (String) Allowed IP list.
- `name` (String) Name of the policy.
